entry.name: fluid.sines~
entry.description: Sinusoidal Modelling process on its audio input.

attributes.name: bandwidth
attributes.digest: Bandwidth
attributes.description: The number of bins used to resynthesise a peak. It has an effect on CPU cost: the widest is more accurate but more computationally expensive. It is capped at (fftSize / 2) + 1. Constraints Minimum: Maximum:

attributes.name: birthhighthreshold
attributes.digest: Track Birth High Frequency Threshold
attributes.description: The threshold in dB above which to consider a peak to start a sinusoidal component tracking, for the high end of the spectrum. It is interpolated across the spectrum until birthLowThreshold at DC. Constraints Minimum: Maximum:

attributes.name: birthlowthreshold
attributes.digest: Track Birth Low Frequency Threshold
attributes.description: The threshold in dB above which to consider a peak to start a sinusoidal component tracking, for the low end of the spectrum. It is interpolated across the spectrum until birthHighThreshold at half-Nyquist. Constraints Minimum: Maximum:

attributes.name: detectionthreshold
attributes.digest: Peak Detection Threshold
attributes.description: The threshold in dB above which a magnitude peak is considered to be a sinusoidal component. Constraints Minimum: Maximum:

attributes.name: fftsettings
attributes.digest: FFT Settings
attributes.description: FFT settings consist of three numbers representing the window size, hop size and FFT size in samples: The hop size and fft size can both be set to -1 (and are by default), with slightly different meanings: Constraints For the hop size, -1 = For the FFT size, -1 =snapped to the nearest equal / greater power of 2 (e.g.=>, butalso =>) Minimum: FFTSize, if != -1, will snap to the next greatest power of two > 4 The maximum FFT size is limited to the value of theargument if FFT size != -1, then window size is clipped at FFT size
